newsitem.title: ESTONIA: VIISNURK MAY PROFIT 1.7 MILLION KROONS.
newsitem.headline: VIISNURK MAY PROFIT 1.7 MILLION KROONS.

text.p: Viisnurk, a ski and furniture manufacturer, said on Monday that its May net profit was 1.7 million kroons and its profit for the first five months of 1997 was 4.6 million kroons.
The cross country ski manufacturer said in a statement that its net turnover for May was 15.1 million kroons and for the first five months of 1997 was 58.9 million kroons.
The better than expected profit was due to increased sales in May, the company said.

"We usually do not sell much this time of year, so the extra sales were a boost but the profit should level out with the forecast in the second half of the year," Andrus Aljus, finance director of Viisnurk, told Reuters.
"Our purchasing managers have been doing a better job than we planned and so our gross margin is also better," he added.
Viisnurk's gross margin was 28.5 percent in the first five months of 1997 compared to 23.7 for 1996, the company said in a statement.
